description: Baseline happy path: an offer follow-up on a consented channel (email), one primary CTA drawn from availableCTAs, claims all in the approved set, and every personalization citing an evidence record. All gates pass; the result is an in_review DRAFT routed to founder approval — NEVER sent. CONVERTED TO v2 (P1.10d-6). The v1 fixture asserted the gate `fos.personalized_follow_up.no-prohibited-guarantee`, which this definition NO LONGER DECLARES — the keyword gate was replaced by the stage-7b semantic classifier in #109/#110, so asserting it is now a distinct grader failure (design section 5 rule 4). Stage-7b coverage is asserted via `compliance_review_blocked: false` instead. v1's `output_schema_constraints` were prose; the mechanizable subset is now `output_assertions`, and the rest stays here, asserted by nothing: the body should read as a personalized message rather than a template (a judgment there is deliberately no operator for), and no send/Gmail-draft/HTTP path may be invoked — an invariant enforced by the ABSENCE of any projection or tool in the definition and asserted by the agent's own FOS1-FOLLOWUP-nosend unit test, which can read canonical state where a transcript grader cannot.
